id: \rDo you have a moment to talk about our lord and savior Arceus?
en: \rDo you have a moment to talk about our lord and savior Arceus?
it: \rHai un momento per parlare del nostro signore e salvatore Arceus?

id: \rBy Arceus's will we exist. Never forget that child.
en: \rBy Arceus's will we exist. Never forget that child.
it: \rEsistiamo per volere di Arceus. Non dimenticarlo mai, figliolo.

id: It's a Pokémon Egg. Would you like to take it with you?
en: It's a Pokémon Egg. Would you like to take it with you?
it: È un Uovo di Pokémon. Vuoi portarlo con te?

id: Oh, you can't carry it with you.
en: Oh, you can't carry it with you.
it: Oh, non puoi portarlo con te.

id: Make some space in your party and come back.
en: Make some space in your party and come back.
it: Fai spazio nella tua squadra e torna qui.

id: \bI've never been able to catch more than one.
en: \bI've never been able to catch more than one.
it: \bNon sono mai riuscito a catturarne più di uno.
\rNiente riuscirà a curare la mia noia?

id: \bI'm a huge fan. I plan on making a movie about them.
en: \bI'm a huge fan. I plan on making a movie about them.
it: \bSono un loro grandissimo fan. Ho in programma di girare un film su di loro.

id: \rI wasn't waiting for you or anything.
en: \rI wasn't waiting for you or anything.

id: \rLeave. What do I care. Everyone else does. It's no big deal. Just do it already. I.'s n.. ..ke it matt... .. ..... ... .. .. ... .\nAre you even listening!?!?!?!
en: \rLeave. What do I care. Everyone else does. It's no big deal. Just do it already. I.'s n.. ..ke it matt... .. ..... ...  .. .. ... .\nAre you even listening!?!?!?!
it: \rVattene. Che m'importa. Lo fanno tutti. Non è un problema. Fallo e basta. N.. ..me se.. ..port... .. ..... ...  .. .. ... .\nMa mi stai almeno ascoltando!?!?!?!
